metadata.title: Large cryptocurrencies climb on XRP, Cardano increases - MarketWatch

content.text:
Crypto Update
Large cryptocurrencies climb on XRP, Cardano increases
All large cryptocurrencies were up during U.S. morning trading on Thursday, with XRP XRP USD seeing the biggest move, jumping 11.01% to $1.22.
Cardano Cardano USD increased 5.21% to 19 cents, while Dogecoin Dogecoin USD increased 4.26% to 8 cents.
